decisions.reason: It has remained on the website and is backed by a quantified customer-saving claim, so the firm has both visible commitment and positive evidence that support continuing it.
A dedicated product page across 2023 and 2024 signals a clear public commitment, and with no reported failure a mature German machinery firm would likely persist rather than reverse course.

The firm publicly reinforced this concept in 2024 with both a quantified savings case and a named customer investment, making withdrawal unlikely given sunk development effort and reputational commitment.
As a 2024 launch with its own page in a core machinery segment, management would likely give it more time and attribute any weak early uptake to temporary market factors.
Although newer and with less visible proof of market success, it still has a dedicated page and fits the firm's mobile processing portfolio, so escalation of commitment points to retention for now.
